data.title: Skyhills Residence 3
data.about:
Sky Hills Residence 3 at JVC is a premier residential development by HRE Developments with two-year post-handover payment plan! It offers luxury studios and 1-2 bedroom apartments. Nestled in the vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle, the two elegantly designed towers provide a tranquil retreat within the city.

The luxury apartments at Sky Hills Residence 3 provide residents with panoramic views of lush green surroundings, perfect for those seeking modern comfort. Amenities include an infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, landscaped gardens, and a multi-purpose room for social gatherings.

Located within walking distance of the future metro station, Sky Hills Residence 3 offers excellent connectivity across Dubai. Investing in Sky Hills Residence 3 promises a high-end lifestyle and great value with a flexible 2-year post-handover payment plan. The master plan of Sky Hills Residence 3 ensures every detail is tailored to premium living.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Urban Elegance with Unmatched Amenities and Prime Connectivity
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime JVC Location: Enjoy a vibrant lifestyle in Dubai’s sought-after community. 
  • Flexible Payment Options: Enjoy an excellent post-handover plan where you only need to pay 40% during construction, 20% when you get the keys, and 40% post-handover in easy installments. 
  • Contemporary Luxury Living: Modern designs and breathtaking views for refined urban comfort. 
  • Exclusive Amenities: Infinity pool, gym, and landscaped spaces for ultimate relaxation. 
  • Future Metro Access: Steps from future metro, enhancing convenience and connectivity.

location_tile.title: The Perfect Blend of Serenity and Connectivity in Dubai’s Prime Locale
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), SkyHills Residence 3 offers the perfect blend of convenience, tranquility, and modern urban living. JVC is one of Dubai's most sought-after communities, known for its strategic location and vibrant ambiance. Designed to create a harmonious balance between nature and city life, this circular-shaped neighborhood is rapidly emerging as a preferred choice for families and professionals alike.

  • 4 Minutes to Dubai Miracle Garden
  • 5 Minutes to Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club
  • 12 Minutes to Dubai Autodrome
  • 12 Minutes to Jumeirah Village Circle
  • 20 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 23 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
